description_en: Removes one or more load balancing server groups from a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB) and Network Load Balancer (NLB)
description_zh: 从伸缩组移除一个或多个负载均衡服务器组，支持的服务器组类型包括应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）和网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer）
kebab_example: aliyun ess detach-server-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --server-group Type=ALB Port=22 ServerGroupId=sgp-1gv2uidn2msy0000 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求之间，该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove ECS instances or elastic container instances in the current scaling group from the server groups to be removed. Valid values:

true: Removes the instances.

false: Does not remove the instances.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否从待移除服务器组中移除当前伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例。 取值范围：

true：移除。

false：不移除。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_detach

fields.help_en:
The port number used by ECS instances or elastic container instances in the load balancing server group.

This parameter is required for ALB and NLB load balancing server groups. This parameter cannot be configured for GWLB load balancing server groups. Settings default value is 6081
fields.help_zh:
负载均衡服务器组中ECS实例或ECI实例使用的端口号。

ALB和NLB类型负载均衡该参数为必填参数，GWLB类型负载均衡不能设置该参数且默认值为6081
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The ID of the load balancing server group
fields.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the load balancing server group. Valid values:

ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB).
NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
GWLB: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)
fields.help_zh:
负载均衡服务器组类型。取值范围：

ALB：应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
NLB：网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer）。
GWLB: 网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The information about the load balancing server groups
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡服务器组的相关信息集合
parameters.name: server_group

ScalingActivityId.description_en:
The ID of the scaling activity that is triggered when ECS instances or elastic container instances are removed from the load balancing server group along with the server group removal.

This parameter is returned only when ForceDetach is set to true
ScalingActivityId.description_zh:
移出负载均衡服务器组，并移出该服务器组内的ECS实例或ECI实例时，伸缩活动的ID。

仅当`ForceDetach`取值为`true`时，返回该参数
